description: A keyboard of three octaves of a 31-note scale tuned in whole number ratios, played by clicking the keys

params.text: Picks the note the scale is built on, C to B
Picks the octave the scale starts in, -4 to 4
Picks which of the five 31-note ratio scales the keys are tuned to, and names each key by its ratio
While on, that note of the scale sounds; it is given a channel of its own, so up to sixteen keys can be on together

outputs.text: The pitch of each key that is on, one per channel, tuned by its ratio in the chosen scale
Carries 10V on the channel of each key that is on and 0V on the rest
Carries 10V on the channel of each key that is on, dropping to 0V for a millisecond whenever a key is switched on

notes: the three columns are the same 31 notes an octave apart, the left column lowest
a key stays on until it is clicked again, so the module holds a chord without anything patched into it
the scales come from res/default_scales_31.json in the installed plugin folder; a scales_31.json placed beside it is read instead, and is used only if it loads without errors
the channels are handed out in the order the keys were pressed and the count is that of the highest channel in use, so releasing an early key leaves a silent channel below the others
